description: Land Title Settlement Department - Thammennagama, Thambutthegama D/S Division, Anuradhapura District - Cad. Map No. 110059
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998. It contains declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels (including parcel numbers, extents, owners, and land classifications) in the Anuradhapura District. The content focuses on land ownership, title settlements, and property registrations, which squarely fits the Land Gazette classification (Type 4) for land and property-related administrative matters.
